```artifact
Feature: Admin and Patient Management

  As an admin, I want to edit lab and pharmacy details so that I can maintain accurate records.
  As a patient, I want to register, update my profile, make appointments, and submit online consultation requests so that I can manage my healthcare effectively.
  As a doctor, I want to provide consultations, prescribe medicine, and lab tests so that I can deliver healthcare services efficiently.

Scenario Outline: Admin and Patient Editing Lab/Pharmacy Details
  Given I am an admin with access to lab and pharmacy details
  When I edit the lab or pharmacy details
  Then the changes should be saved and reflected in the system

Examples:
  | Given                                  | When                                  | Then                                                      |
  | I am logged into the admin system         | I navigate to the lab/pharmacy details | The updated details should be saved and displayed                 |
  | I am logged into the admin system         | I attempt to edit non-existent details | An error message should be displayed                           |
  | I am logged into the admin system         | I edit the details with invalid data    | An error message should be displayed                           |

Scenario Outline: Patient Registration and Profile Update
  Given I am a patient with access to registration and profile update
  When I register or update my profile
  Then the changes should be saved and reflected in the system

Examples:
  | Given                                  | When                                  | Then                                                      |
  | I am logged into the patient system      | I navigate to the registration page   | The registration should be successful and saved                   |
  | I am logged into the patient system      | I attempt to register with invalid data | An error message should be displayed                           |
  | I am logged into the patient system      | I navigate to the profile update page | The profile update should be successful and saved                   |

Scenario Outline: Patient Appointments and Online Consultation Requests
  Given I am a patient with access to appointments and online consultation requests
  When I make an appointment or submit an online consultation request
  Then the request should be saved and reflected in the system

Examples:
  | Given                                  | When                                  | Then                                                      |
  | I am logged into the patient system      | I navigate to the appointment page   | The appointment should be successful and saved                   |
  | I am logged into the patient system      | I submit an online consultation request | The request should be successful and saved                   |

Scenario Outline: Prescription Reports and Invoices Generation
  Given I am a patient with access to prescription reports and invoices
  When I view or generate prescription reports and invoices
  Then the reports and invoices should be available and accurate

Examples:
  | Given                                  | When                                  | Then                                                      |
  | I am logged into the patient system      | I navigate to the prescription reports page | The reports should be available and accurate                   |
  | I am logged into the patient system      | I attempt to generate invoices with invalid data | An error message should be displayed                           |

Scenario Outline: Doctor Consultation and Prescription
  Given I am a doctor with access to consultation and prescription
  When I provide a consultation or prescribe medicine
  Then the consultation should be recorded and the medicine should be prescribed

Examples:
  | Given                                  | When                                  | Then                                                      |
  | I am logged into the doctor system      | I navigate to the consultation page   | The consultation should be recorded and successful                 |
  | I am logged into the doctor system      | I attempt to prescribe medicine without authorization | An error message should be displayed                           |

Scenario Outline: Doctor Lab Test Prescription
  Given I am a doctor with access to lab test prescription
  When I prescribe a lab test
  Then the lab test should be prescribed and recorded

Examples:
  | Given                                  | When                                  | Then                                                      |
  | I am logged into the doctor system      | I navigate to the lab test prescription page | The lab test prescription should be successful and recorded                 |

```
